mathematical_delta: Proved that every restriction-critical Boolean h with R>2+2/ln2 has every coordinate influence at most kappa(R) and at most e^3 2^{-R}. Consequently any FEI counterfamily can be chosen restriction-critical, tensor-prime, and exponentially diffuse in H/I. Also proved a dimension-independent FEI bound G(delta) for the restricted critical class having one influence at least fixed delta. Full FEI remains open.
